_comment: The cinematic key light on a shot's subject ship (M8-T29, maintainer 2026-11-19: the show always key-lit its ships, even in deep space): a soft light from the sun's side at distance_m, and an optional rim from behind. Lights only the subject's surroundings (range_m); on only while a cinematic shot plays. Energy is Godot's light_energy; colour linear RGB.
